At Walstar Technologies I redesigned a domain-specific RAG chatbot (Mistral, LangChain) with custom chunking and re-ranking, improving answer quality by 30% and cutting user-facing errors by 25% across 100+ test cases. In my Multimodal Math Mentor project, a 5-agent LangGraph pipeline with a Human-in-the-Loop checkpoint gave 25% fewer hallucinations on the eval set.

That maps directly to your work on RAG pipelines and evaluation tooling with Python, PyTorch and LLMs, which is the stack I build with every day.

I graduate from VIT Vellore in 2026 with a B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering and can join immediately, remote, hybrid or onsite. GitHub: https://github.com/vedantp3 Portfolio: https://vedantpatil.vercel.app Resume attached.
